name: Leonard
source:
He is the head of the Japan branch of the "Morning Star Knights", and one of the top executives of the Knights. He has extremely high abilities and is currently considered the strongest among men in terms of ability.

He has a gentle demeanor and is the leader of the moderate faction that believes in fighting to protect the abilities of others. However, he will not hesitate to fight if necessary and is highly respected in the Knights for taking the lead on the front lines.

He was also the best friend of Minami's late brother and trusts Minami completely. He is very close to Minami.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/BTyqayj.jpeg]official character decription[/url]]
